sources.facts: National authority places the temple at Trại Mát. Describes a 37 m, seven-storey Linh Tháp in front of the Dragon Garden and ceramic work along the main hall.
Provincial gazetteer records construction commencing in 1949 and extended renovation from 1990 onward. The temple is known for inlaid ceramics.
Province identifies the seven-storey Linh Tháp, large bell, glazed ceramics and the garden’s separate 49 m dragon artwork.
Provincial guide gives a 33 m by 12 m main hall, double rows of columns and 37 m tower.
